title: glassbrain graph
description: One file of a glassbrain knowledge graph. A graph is nodes plus edges; structure comes from `parent` (containment), not from edges. Several files in one folder are merged into one graph (same id = same node). Unknown fields are kept and shown in the detail panel.

name.description: Title of this file (shown as its source name).

id.description: Stable identity. Keep it the same across versions: that is how a diff knows it is the same thing.

label.description: Display name. Falls back to `name`, then `id`.

kind.description: What sort of thing this is. Colors come from the profile's `nodePalette[kind]`; kinds not in the palette are drawn as skeleton.

parent.description: Id of the node this one sits inside. This is the only source of structure: the layout is built from it.

layer.description: Layer id (for the 2.5D plane view). Defaults to the profile's first layer.

flags.description: Boolean markers; each becomes a CSS-like class. A flag listed in the profile's `placeholderFlags` draws the node as a placeholder.

description.description: Markdown shown in the detail panel. `[text](node:<id>)` links jump to another node.

source.description: Node id the edge starts at.

target.description: Node id the edge points to.

kind.description: Relation type. Colors come from the profile's `edgePalette[kind]`. An edge is identified by its two ends plus its kind.
